hero.subheadline: In 60 seconds you'll know what's costing you visitors, search rankings, and legal risk.

categories.title: We check what actually matters.
categories.subtitle: Poor performance, broken SEO, and missing compliance cost you visitors, revenue, and credibility every day your site stays unfixed.

performance.title: Performance & Speed
performance.description: Slow pages lose visitors before they even load. Google ranks them lower too. We measure the same things Google does when deciding where your site appears.

seo.title: SEO
seo.description: If search engines can't read your pages properly, customers won't find you. We check whether Google can discover, understand, and rank your site.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.description: Since June 2025, most EU businesses are legally required to have accessible websites. We check if yours meets the requirements.

legal.title: EU Legal Compliance
legal.description: Missing cookie consent, no privacy policy, tracking before user approval. These are the things that lead to fines.

security.title: Security
security.description: Outdated software and missing security headers make your site an easy target. Most of these issues are invisible until something breaks.

standards.title: Modern Web Standards
standards.description: Broken mobile layouts, deprecated code, missing pages. These signal to visitors that your business doesn't invest in its online presence.

reportPreview.title: What your report looks like
reportPreview.subtitle: Every failed check includes what's wrong and how to resolve it.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.subtitle: No account needed. Results go straight to your inbox.

step1.title: Paste your URL
step1.description: Any publicly accessible website. WordPress, Wix, custom built, anything.

step2.title: Enter your email
step2.description: We send the full report to your inbox when it's done. Nothing else.

step3.title: Get your report
step3.description: Scores, issues, and recommendations across all six categories. Share it with your team or your developer.

audience.title: Who this is for
audience.subtitle: Whether you run the website or report on it.

business.title: Business owners
business.description: You know your site needs work but not what's wrong or where to start. This report gives you the answers.

marketing.title: Marketing managers
marketing.description: You need hard numbers to justify a website investment to leadership. This report is the business case.

developer.title: Developers
developer.description: A quick audit across performance, security, and standards without running five different tools.

agency.title: Agencies
agency.description: Send clients a scored report instead of explaining why their site needs a rebuild. Let the numbers talk.

compliance.title: The EU Accessibility Act is law.
compliance.description: Since June 2025, businesses with 10+ employees or €2M+ turnover must meet WCAG 2.1 AA. Non-compliance means fines up to €3M. Most Swedish businesses don't know this applies to them yet.

gdpr.title: Cookie compliance is not optional.
gdpr.description: Your cookie banner needs an equally prominent reject button. Loading analytics before consent is a direct GDPR violation. IMY has been issuing formal warnings to Swedish businesses since April 2025.

stat1.label: Of global turnover, maximum GDPR fine

stat3.label: Must be as prominent as Accept

faq.title: Questions & answers
faq.subtitle: What you need to know before scanning.

items.question: Is this really free?
items.answer: Yes. No credit card, no hidden costs, no catch.

items.question: What happens with my email?
items.answer: We use it to send your report. That's it. No newsletters, no sharing with third parties.

items.question: How long does the scan take?
items.answer: About 60 seconds. We run automated checks against your site covering all six categories in real time.

items.question: What does the report include?
items.answer: A score for each of the six categories, a list of every issue we found, and what to do about each one.

items.question: Who is Vivotiv?
items.answer: A Swedish company that helps businesses modernize their websites. We built this scan to show site owners exactly what they're missing.

bottomCta.title: Your website has problems you can't see.
bottomCta.subtitle: 60 seconds. No signup, no credit card.
